mapper.sql: id, space_id, event_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, recipient_prior_role, accepted_at, handover_ends_at, CAST(permission_snapshot AS text) AS permission_snapshot
mapper.select: SELECT FROM owner_transfers WHERE id = #{id} AND event_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM owner_transfers WHERE id = #{id} AND space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.id AS transfer_id, t.space_id, s.name AS space_name, t.event_id, e.name AS event_name, t.from_user_id, fu.display_name AS from_display_name, t.to_user_id, tu.display_name AS to_display_name, t.status, t.accepted_at, t.handover_ends_at FROM owner_transfers t JOIN spaces s ON s.id = t.space_id JOIN events e ON e.id = t.event_id AND e.space_id = t.space_id JOIN users fu ON fu.id = t.from_user_id JOIN users tu ON tu.id = t.to_user_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.event_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO owner_transfers ( id, space_id, event_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, permission_snapshot) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, 'PENDING', '[]'::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE owner_transfers SET status = #{handoverStatus}, recipient_prior_role = #{priorRole}, accepted_at = #{acceptedAt}, handover_ends_at = #{endsAt}, permission_snapshot = CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id} AND space_id = #{spaceId} AND status = #{pendingStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_user_permissions ( space_id, event_id, user_id, permission, effect, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{userId}, item->>'permission', item->>'effect', (item->>'grantedBy')::uuid, (item->>'grantedAt')::timestamptz FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb)) AS item
